fusions.name: Broadhead Count
fusions.desc: Looses a broadhead at the first enemy in line for 8 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill returns one.

fusions.name: Full Draw
fusions.desc: A full-draw shot that deals 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles, and leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Against a boss or elite it deals a further 5% of the target's maximum health.

fusions.name: Anchor Hold
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

fusions.name: String at Tension
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
